```{r Data frames}
############ FULL df for accuracy
df_accuracy <- read_excel("./dataframes/df_accuracy.xlsx")

#order of distractors for plot --- IMPORTANT to have them displayed in the right distractor order
df_accuracy$distractor <- factor(df_accuracy$distractor,
                             levels = c("Zero", "One_Near", "One_Far", "Three"),
                             labels = c("0", "1 Near", "1 Far", "3"))

#df accuracy by position
df_acc_front <- subset(df_accuracy,  position == "Front")
df_acc_rear <- subset(df_accuracy,  position == "Rear")
df_acc_valid_rear <- subset(df_acc_rear,  cue == "Valid")
df_acc_invalid_rear <- subset(df_acc_rear,  cue == "Invalid")

#df accuracy with distractors categorized (One near and three in Present; one far and zero in Absent)
df_recat_acc <- read_excel("C:/Users/deschane/Documents/abc1_data/htc_vive_vision_test/full-notebook-analysis-article/1. performences analysis/1.1. data processing/dataframes/df_recat_acc.xlsx")
df_front_acc_recat <-  subset(df_recat_acc,  position == "Front")

########### FULL df for reaction time : 
df_success_trials <- read_excel("C:/Users/deschane/Documents/abc1_data/htc_vive_vision_test/full-notebook-analysis-article/1. performences analysis/1.1. data processing/dataframes/df_success_trials.xlsx")

#order of distractors for plot --- IMPORTANT to have them displayed in the right distractor order
df_success_trials$distractor <- factor(df_success_trials$distractor,
                                      levels = c("Zero", "One_Near", "One_Far", "Three"),
                                      labels = c("0", "1 Near", "1 Far", "3"))
#df by cue
df_RT_front_valid <- subset(df_success_trials,  cue == "Valid")
#dfs by position
df_RT_front <- subset(df_success_trials,  position == "Front")
df_RT_rear <- subset(df_success_trials,  position == "Rear")
#by cue * position
df_RT_front_inv <- subset(df_RT_front,  cue == "Invalid")
df_RT_front_val <- subset(df_RT_front,  cue == "Valid")
df_RT_rear_val <- subset(df_RT_rear,  cue == "Valid")
df_RT_rear_inv <- subset(df_RT_rear,  cue == "Invalid")

#df front distractor recategorization
df_recategorized_RT_front <- df_RT_front

df_recategorized_RT_front$distractor_react <- ifelse(
  df_recategorized_RT_front$distractor %in% c("1 Near", "3"),
  "Present",
  ifelse(df_recategorized_RT_front$distractor %in% c("1 Far", "0"),
         "Absent",
         NA)
)
############################################ BIG PROBLEM IN THE RECATEGORIZATION
print("done")
```
```{r Figure 4. Response time difference depending on cue and position ---------- violin plot}
# Compute means
mean_summary <- df_success_trials %>%
  group_by(cue, position) %>%
  summarise(mean_RT = mean(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Shared dodge
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

p <- ggplot(
  df_success_trials,
  aes(x = cue, y = responseTime, fill = position, color = position)
) +
  
  # Half-eye cloud (OFFSET CONTROL HERE)
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    side = "right",
    adjust = 0.7,
    width = 0.5,
    .width = 0,
    justification = -0.35,   # <- shift clouds relative to dots
    point_colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.8,
    position = pd
  ) +
  
  # Raw data (rain)
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.7
    ),
    alpha = 0.3,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # Boxplot (centered)
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = interaction(cue, position)),
    position = pd,
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Mean connecting lines (aligned)
  geom_line(
    data = mean_summary,
    aes(y = mean_RT, group = position),
    position = pd,
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.7,
    color = "black",
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Response Time by Cue and Position",
    x = "Cue",
    y = "Response Time (s)",
    color = "Position",
    fill = "Position"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Front" = "#00FFFF", "Rear" = "#FF4500")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Front" = "#00FFFF", "Rear" = "#FF4500"))

print(p)
```


```{r Figure 4. Response time difference depending on cue and position}
summary_df <- df_success_trials %>%
  group_by(cue, position) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_RT = mean(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RT   = sd(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    n       = n(),
    se_RT   = sd_RT / sqrt(n),
    ci_low  = mean_RT - qt(.975, n - 1) * se_RT,
    ci_high = mean_RT + qt(.975, n - 1) * se_RT,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
p <- ggplot() +
  # Raw individual points
  geom_point(
    data = df_success_trials,
    aes(x = cue, y = responseTime, color = position),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      dodge.width = 0.2
    ),
    alpha = 0.2,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # Lines connecting raw means
  geom_line(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(x = cue, y = mean_RT, group = position, color = position),
    position = position_dodge(0.2),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # Points for raw means
  geom_point(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(x = cue, y = mean_RT, color = position),
    position = position_dodge(0.2),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  # Raw 95% CI error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = cue,
      y = mean_RT,
      ymin = ci_low,
      ymax = ci_high,
      group = position   # keep grouping for dodging
    ),
    color = "black",     # fixed color → black
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(0.2),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Response Time by Cue and Position",
    x = "Cue",
    y = "Response Time (s)",
    color = "Position"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Front" = "#00FFFF", "Rear" = "#FF4500"))

print(p)
```

```{r Figure 5. Response time depending on distractor (valid trials)}
summary_distractor <- df_success_trials %>%
  filter(cue == "Invalid") %>%   # optional, only valid trials
  group_by(distractor, position) %>%
  summarise(
    median_RT = median(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RT     = sd(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = n(),
    se_RT     = sd_RT / sqrt(n),
    ci_low    = median_RT - qt(.975, n - 1) * se_RT,
    ci_high   = median_RT + qt(.975, n - 1) * se_RT,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#plot

p_distractor <- ggplot(
  df_success_trials %>% filter(cue == "Invalid"),
  aes(x = distractor, y = responseTime, fill = position)
) +
  
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
  ) +
  
  # Half-eye densities
  stat_halfeye(
    side = "right",
    adjust = 0.7,
    width = 0.5,
    .width = 0,
    justification = -0.3,
    point_colour = NA,
    alpha = 1,
    aes(fill = position),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
  ) +
  
  # Jittered points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = position),
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 1.5,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.7,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +
  
  # Median lines
  geom_line(
    data = summary_distractor,
    aes(x = distractor, y = median_RT, group = position),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Styling
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Response Time on Invalid Trials by Distractor",
    x = "Distractor",
    y = "Response Time (s)"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Zero", "One\nNear", "One\nFar", "Three")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Front" = "#00FFFF", "Rear" = "#FF4500")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Front" = "#00FFFF", "Rear" = "#FF4500")) +
  ylim(0.3, 2.7)

print(p_distractor)


```


```{r  Response time depending on distractor (valid and invalid trials)}
summary_distractor <- df_success_trials %>%
  group_by(cue, distractor, position) %>%
  summarise(
    median_RT = median(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RT     = sd(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = n(),
    se_RT     = sd_RT / sqrt(n),
    ci_low    = median_RT - qt(.975, n - 1) * se_RT,
    ci_high   = median_RT + qt(.975, n - 1) * se_RT,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# plot

p_distractor <- ggplot(
  df_success_trials,
  aes(x = distractor, y = responseTime, fill = position)
) +
  
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
  ) +
  
  # Half-eye densities
  stat_halfeye(
    side = "right",
    adjust = 0.7,
    width = 0.5,
    .width = 0,
    justification = -0.3,
    point_colour = NA,
    alpha = 1,
    aes(fill = position),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
  ) +
  
  # Jittered points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = position),
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 1.5,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.7,
      seed = 123
    )
  ) +
  
  # Median lines

    geom_line(
    data = summary_distractor,
    aes(x = distractor, y = median_RT, group = position),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Create the two panels
  facet_wrap(~ cue, nrow = 1) +
  
  # Styling
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Response Time by Distractor and Cue",
    x = "Distractor",
    y = "Response Time (s)"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Zero", "One\nNear", "One\nFar", "Three")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Front" = "#00FFFF", "Rear" = "#FF4500")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Front" = "#00FFFF", "Rear" = "#FF4500")) +
  #ylim(0.3, 2.7)   # ensures identical y-axis
  scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(0.3, 3.3),
  breaks = seq(0.5, 3, by = 0.5)
)



print(p_distractor)

ggsave("distAndCueRT.svg", plot = p_distractor, width = 8, height = 6)



```

```{r intercation plot}
summary_interaction <- df_success_trials %>%
  group_by(position, cue, distractor) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_RT = mean(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_RT = sd(responseTime, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_interaction <- ggplot(summary_interaction,
       aes(x = distractor,
           y = mean_RT,
           color = cue,
           group = cue)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_RT - se_RT,
      ymax = mean_RT + se_RT
    ),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ position) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Interaction of Cue and Distractor on Response Time",
    x = "Distractor",
    y = "Mean Response Time (s)",
    color = "Cue"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Zero", "One\nNear", "One\nFar", "Three")) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Valid" = "#1f77b4",
    "Invalid" = "#d62728"
  ))

print(p_interaction)

```

```{r Global Reaction Time analysis}
#descriptive statistics

describeBy(df_success_trials$responseTime, df_success_trials$cue)
describeBy(df_success_trials$responseTime, df_success_trials$distractor)
describeBy(df_success_trials$responseTime, df_success_trials$position)

################# ________________Anova reaction time___________________________
# Table 2 : Type III Repeated-Measures ANOVA for all reaction time
modelRT <- aov_ez(
  id = "participant",                 # subject identifier
  dv = "responseTime",                 # dependent variable
  data = df_success_trials,                  # your dataset
  within = c("cue", "position", "distractor") # repeated factors
)
summary(modelRT)
effectsize::eta_squared(modelRT)


################# ________________Post-hoc RT___________________________________

#cue
m_cue <- lmer(responseTime ~ cue + (1 | participant), data = df_success_trials)
emm1 <- emmeans(m_cue, ~ cue) #Get Estimated Marginal Means (EMMs)
pairs(emm1, adjust = "none")#Perform Pairwise Post Hoc Comparisons

#distractor 
m_distractor2 <- lmer(responseTime ~ distractor + (1 | participant), data = df_success_trials)
emm <- emmeans(m_distractor2, ~ distractor) 
pairs(emm, adjust = "none") 

#position
m_pos <- lmer(responseTime ~ position + (1 | participant), data = df_success_trials)
emm2 <- emmeans(m_pos, ~ position) #Get Estimated Marginal Means (EMMs)
pairs(emm2, adjust = "none")#Perform Pairwise Post Hoc Comparisons
```

```{r Front Reaction time : Table 4 Type II Analysis of Variance Table with Satterthwaite's method for front reaction time}

describeBy(df_RT_front$responseTime, df_RT_front$distractor)
```

```{r  plot fig X. Accuracy plot for front }
#### figure for accuracy front
df_front <- df_full %>% filter(position == "Front")

summary_front <- df_front %>%
  group_by(cue, distractor) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_acc = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_acc = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot() +
  # Points participants d'abord (en arrière-plan)
   geom_point(
  data = df_front,
  aes(x = distractor, y = accuracy, shape = cue),
  color = "black",
  alpha = 0.30,
  size = 1.2,
  position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, seed = 123)
) +
  
  # Barres d'erreur en PREMIER
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_front,
    aes(x = distractor, y = mean_acc, 
        ymin = mean_acc - se_acc, ymax = mean_acc + se_acc,
        group = cue),
    color = "black",
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.6),
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  # Lignes de connexion
  geom_line(
    data = summary_front,
    aes(x = distractor, y = mean_acc, 
        group = cue, linetype = cue),
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(0.6)
  ) +
  # Points moyens par DESSUS (en dernier)
  geom_point(
    data = summary_front,
    aes(x = distractor, y = mean_acc, shape = cue),
    fill = "#00FFFF",
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    position = position_dodge(0.6)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Distractor", y = "Accuracy") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Valid" = 21, "Invalid" = 24)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Valid" = "solid", "Invalid" = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Zero", "One\nNear", "One\nFar", "Three")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.60, 1.0), 
                     breaks = seq(0.60, 1.0, by = 0.05)) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r plot plot fig X. Accuracy plot for front recategorized}
  size = 1.2,
  position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, seed = 123)
) +

  # Barres d'erreur en PREMIER
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_front_recat,
    aes(x = distractor1, y = mean_acc, 
        ymin = mean_acc - se_acc, ymax = mean_acc + se_acc,
        group = cue),
    color = "black",
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.6),
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  # Lignes de connexion
  geom_line(
    data = summary_front_recat,
    aes(x = distractor1, y = mean_acc, 
        group = cue, linetype = cue),
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(0.6)
  ) +
  # Points moyens par DESSUS (en dernier)
  geom_point(
    data = summary_front_recat,
    aes(x = distractor1, y = mean_acc, shape = cue),
    fill = "#00FFFF",
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    position = position_dodge(0.6)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Distractor", y = "Accuracy") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Valid" = 21, "Invalid" = 24)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Valid" = "solid", "Invalid" = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Present", "Absent")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.60, 1.0), 
                     breaks = seq(0.60, 1.0, by = 0.05)) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

```
